references.text: Joshua's earlier instructions to lure the enemy out of the city by pretending to flee, which caused the people of Ai to pursue them
The continuation of the event where all the men left the city to pursue Israel, leaving the city open and undefended
The first battle against Ai in which the Israelites fled and the men of Ai pursued them, but on that occasion it was a genuine flight
A similar military strategy used by Israel against Benjamin at Gibeah, where they lured the enemy out of the city by pretending to flee
The ambush strategy against Gibeah that mirrors Joshua's tactics against Ai, in which the enemy was drawn away from the city
